partial.silent: No audio is being sent right now.
partial.label: What the microphone hears right now

nameRound.title: Name round
nameRound.say: Say <q>My name is …</q> one at a time.
nameRound.why: Then your names stand in the notes instead of Speaker 1, Speaker 2.
nameRound.fixLater: Names with a question mark can be corrected in the speaker list when the round is done.
nameRound.done: Done, everyone has said their name

doc.staleNone: Not updated yet · we retry automatically
doc.first: The first notes arrive within a minute
doc.newTab: (Google Doc, opens in a new tab)

stopCopy: The audio is switched off and the notes get a final pass. It takes about a minute. What you already see in the document stays.

resume.elsewhereTitle: The meeting is being recorded on another computer
resume.elsewhereText: The meeting in {org} started at {time} and is being recorded in another tab right now. If you take over here, the other tab stops listening. Everything said is kept.
resume.notEndedText: The meeting in {org} started at {time}, but nobody is recording it right now. Perhaps the tab was closed or the computer went to sleep. Everything transcribed so far is kept.
resume.autoEnd: If nobody continues within a few minutes, the meeting ends by itself and the notes are finished.

banners.mintCap: The connection to the transcription has broken too many times in this meeting. End it and start a new meeting. What has already been said stays in the document.
banners.token: We couldn't reach the transcription after three tries. We retry every 30 seconds and hold on to what's said for up to a minute. What has already been said stays in the document.
banners.mic: The microphone couldn't be started. Check that it's on and that no other app is using it. What has already been said stays in the document.
banners.silent: No audio is being sent right now. What has already been said stays in the document.
banners.docConnected: Google withdrew the permission. The transcription continues, and everything is written into the document once you've signed in.
banners.docOffline: Google withdrew the permission. Everything is written into the document once you've signed in.
banners.timeTitle: The meeting ends automatically in {minutes} min
banners.audioWaiting: The audio is waiting in the browser
banners.offline: No internet connection. The audio is held in the browser for up to a minute and sent when the network is back. Nothing is stored on the computer.
banners.broken: The connection broke. The audio is held in the browser for up to a minute and sent when we're back. You don't need to do anything.
banners.more: Show {count, plural, one {1 more warning} other {# more warnings}}

stop.meeting_length: The meeting reached the 4-hour limit and ended automatically.
stop.org_month: The association has used its 20 hours this month, so the meeting ended automatically. The time is topped up on the 1st.
stop.global: Simon Says has reached today's limit for the whole service, so the meeting ended automatically. You can start meetings again tomorrow.
stop.kill_switch: The service is paused right now, so the meeting ended automatically.
stop.el_service: The transcription service's quota is used up – tell whoever runs Simon Says. The meeting ended automatically.

warn.org_month: The association's 20 hours for this month are running out. The time is topped up on the 1st.
warn.global: Simon Says is nearing today's limit for the whole service. You can start meetings again tomorrow.
warn.default: A meeting can be at most 4 hours. If you need more time, end it and start a new meeting.

ended.membersFailed: {count, plural, one {One member} other {# members}} didn't get access – share the document manually.
ended.sharedWith: and shared with the association's members
ended.waitingTitle: {count, plural, one {# line is} other {# lines are}} waiting for the network – don't close the tab
ended.waitingText: What was said last hasn't reached the server yet. We keep retrying; leave the tab open until this goes away.
ended.signedOutUnsent: You're signed out – {count, plural, one {# line isn't} other {# lines aren't}} saved
ended.signedOutEnd: You're signed out – the meeting couldn't be ended
ended.signedOutText: Sign in again (opens in a new tab) and then press Try again, so the rest is saved and the meeting ends. If you close the tab now, the meeting still ends within a quarter of an hour, but without those lines.
ended.endFailedText: We couldn't reach the server. Check the network and try again. If you close the tab, the meeting still ends within a quarter of an hour.
ended.finalizingText: You talked for {duration}. The notes are getting a final pass; it takes about a minute.
ended.canClose: You can close the tab, it will finish anyway.
ended.doneShared: You talked for {duration}. The notes are done.{shared}
ended.done: You talked for {duration}. The notes are done{shared}.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.empty: Speakers show up here when they start talking.
speakers.name: Name

mic-denied.title: The microphone is blocked
mic-denied.text: Click the padlock or the microphone icon in the address bar, choose Allow and press Start again.

mic-missing.title: No microphone found
mic-missing.text: Check that the computer has a microphone that's switched on, and that no other app is using it.

start-failed.title: The meeting couldn't start
start-failed.text: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a little while.

limit.title: This month's time is used up
limit.text: The association has used its 20 hours this month. The time is topped up on the 1st.

consent.title: Before you begin
consent.laptop: The laptop listens with its own microphone. Put it in the middle of the table.
consent.agendaDoc: The notes are written in the chosen agenda
consent.agendaWithTranscript: , with the full transcript in a tab of its own.
consent.agendaNoTranscript: . The transcript isn't put in the document.
consent.newDoc: The notes are written in a new Google Doc in your Drive and shared with the association's members
consent.newWithTranscript: , with the full transcript in a tab of its own.
consent.pause: Pause stops the audio at once.
consent.lid: Keep the lid open and plug in the charger – if the lid closes, the laptop stops listening.
consent.works: The microphone works, we hear you.
consent.everyone: Everyone in the room knows the meeting is transcribed and can ask for a pause
consent.agendaFirst: Choose an agenda or create a new document first.

meeting.leaveLive: The meeting is in progress — leave the page?
meeting.leaveNotEnded: The meeting hasn't ended — leave the page?
meeting.leaveLiveText: If you leave the page, the laptop stops listening, but the meeting doesn't end. You can continue it from the association's page.
meeting.leaveText: The meeting doesn't end when you leave the page. You can continue it, or end it, from the association's page.
meeting.privacy: No audio recording is stored. Read more in the <link>privacy information</link>.

agenda.missing: The agenda lacks: {items}. Simon Says doesn't add items to your document.
agenda.folderNamedAnnounce: Your Google account hasn't opened the meeting folder {folder} yet.
agenda.folderAnnounce: Your Google account hasn't opened the meeting folder yet.
agenda.preparedFor: Prepared for {date} · {type}. Last week's tasks are already under “Från förra veckan” (From last week).
agenda.pickerOff: The Google picker isn't set up yet.
agenda.otherAccount: It was prepared with another Google account. Open it once in the Google picker, so Simon Says can write in it.
agenda.folderNamed: The association's meeting folder is called {folder}. Your Google account hasn't opened it yet. Choose it once in the Google picker, and the meeting document goes there.
agenda.folder: The association has a meeting folder, but your Google account hasn't opened it yet. Choose it once in the Google picker, and the meeting document goes there.
agenda.none: No agenda – create a new document in the format {format}
agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.transcript: Put the transcript in the document?
agenda.folderReadFailed: We couldn't read the meeting folder right now.
agenda.pickerFailed: The Google picker couldn't be opened. Try again.
agenda.folderSaveFailed: The meeting folder couldn't be saved. Try again.

controller.offline: We couldn't reach the server. Check the network and try again.
controller.orgBusy: Another meeting is in progress in the association. End it first.
controller.tooOld: The meeting was interrupted more than two hours ago and can't continue. Start a new meeting.
controller.goneText: The meeting wasn't found, so no more audio is sent from this tab. Go back to the association.
controller.wrongAccountTitle: You're signed in with the wrong account
controller.wrongAccountText: The account isn't in the association. Sign in with your association account again; no more audio is sent from this tab.
controller.signedOutTitle: You're signed out — sign in again
controller.signedOutText: What's said is held in the browser and sent once you've signed in. Don't close this tab.
controller.noAudioText: The computer may have gone to sleep or the microphone been disconnected. We're trying to start it again. If that doesn't help: reload the page and press Resume the meeting.
controller.postsTitle: The transcription isn't getting through right now
controller.postsText: We retry automatically and nothing is thrown away. Don't close this tab.
controller.quietText: Check that the microphone isn't muted or covered and that the laptop is in the middle of the table. If the room is just quiet, you can ignore this.
controller.shareTitle: {count, plural, one {One member} other {# members}} didn't get access – share the document manually
controller.shareText: Google didn't let us share the meeting document with everyone in the association. Open the document and share it with them using the Share button.
controller.folderTitle: The document ended up in your Drive
controller.folderText: Your Google account hasn't opened the association's meeting folder, so the document is in “Simon Says – {org}”. The members have got it. Next time: press “Use the meeting folder” before starting.
controller.missingTitle: Items the statutes require are missing
controller.supersededTitle: The meeting is running in another tab
controller.supersededText: The meeting continued in another tab or on another computer, so this tab stopped listening. You can close it.
